turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Patil from Delhi?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, speaking. Who is this please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Anjali from the City Police Community Outreach cell, sir. I am calling to let you know that we are seeing a lot of fraud cases in your area lately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh dear, is that so? I have been getting many strange calls since morning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Exactly why I am calling. We want to warn you that the police or any bank officer will never ask you for an OTP or your PIN over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But what if they say it is for a refund or some government scheme?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is the trick, sir. Even if they mention a specific amount, like twelve thousand rupees or more, just hang up immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I see. I was actually worried about a message I got about a payment today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please ignore those messages and do not click any links. Just remember that your Aadhaar and bank details should never be shared with anyone calling you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you for the warning, beta. You are very kind to call and tell me this.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is my duty, Mr. Patil. Stay safe and please tell your neighbors as well.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I will definitely do that. Have a good day.
